name: PyRIT
what_it_does: Python Risk Identification Toolkit for generative AI. Orchestrates attack prompts against target endpoints, supports multi-turn scoring, and integrates with custom converters and scorers for systematic adversarial evaluation.
what_it_doesnt_do: Does not ship with a turnkey UI or a curated attack-pattern library out of the box — you write the orchestrators. Does not include any reporting layer suitable for executive deliverables; expect to build that on top.
best_for: Detection engineers and ML engineers who want a programmatic, scriptable harness
Custom attack development against your own model endpoints
not_for: Teams expecting a click-and-test commercial product
First-week-of-an-AI-red-team-program proof of concept where you need a demo today
team_skill_required: Python proficient; comfortable building custom orchestrators and scorers.
